note: EV-25 answer file. Written before any live run and never changed after it. Each page starts with none of the template signs of the Template tells section of GUIDELINES.md. lazy_signs are the GUIDELINES.md entry titles that a quick fix of the defects would add; honest_fix is the plain fix that needs no sign.

pages.product: Tidewell, tide times for small harbors
defects: The hero is flat and empty: a narrow text column at the left and about two thirds of the hero width blank, so the first screen has no focus and looks unfinished.
The one concrete thing the page has, today's tide table, sits below the hero in 12 px and 13 px text, cramped and easy to miss.
The headline is only 30 px, so it does not hold the large empty hero.
lazy_signs: Color washes and blurred blobs behind content
Glossy 3D blob as the hero visual
Empty box or generic picture as the hero visual
pages.honest_fix: Move the tide table up into the empty half of the hero at a readable size, as the product visual, and scale the headline up.

pages.product: Plotwise, plot booking for community gardens
defects: The four feature cards have no anchor: each title is the same size, weight, and color as its text and sits with no space above the text, so the eye finds no entry point.
The section heading "What Plotwise does" is set at the same size and in the same gray as the card text, so it does not lead the section.
The cards and their text share one muted gray, so the row reads as one gray band.
lazy_signs: Feature cards with an emoji and a bold title
pages.honest_fix: Give the card titles and the section heading a size or weight step and a darker text color, and space the title from its line.

defects: The headline is weaker than the text under it: 22 px in light gray above a 20 px lead paragraph in near-black, so the lead reads first.
The navigation links are 20 px, about as large as the headline, so they compete with it.
Two actions do the same job: the hero button "See boats and dates" and the search form's "Search" button, and it is unclear which to use.
lazy_signs: Gradient text in headings, numbers, or the logo
Too many type sizes and weights on one screen
pages.honest_fix: Set the headline large and dark, step the lead down, set the navigation smaller, and make one of the two actions the clear one.

defects: The primary action "Start a 30-day trial" does not stand out: a pale beige button with gray text, almost the same as the secondary button beside it.
The strongest button on the screen is "Sign in" in the header, a solid dark red fill, so the eye goes to it before the trial.
The three facts under the hero have no heading, so they read as loose captions, and the lower third of the screen is blank.
pages.honest_fix: Give the trial button the solid brand fill, set Sign in as a plain link, and keep the secondary button quiet.
